newsitem.title: DENMARK: Royal Copenhagen silent on Orrefors.
newsitem.headline: Royal Copenhagen silent on Orrefors.

text.p: Danish porcelain and silver group Royal Copenhagen on Friday refused to comment on a statement by Sweden's Proventus AB saying that the Danish company's increased stake in another Swede, Orrefors Kosta Boda, could be the first phase in a takeover bid.
"We are taking the situation calmly, but would rather not comment further," Managing Director Leonhard Schroeder said.

Royal Copenhagen, 82 percent owned by Danish brewer Carlsberg last Wednesday said that it had raised to 17.1 percent its holding in Orrefors, an upmarket glassmaker, with whom it made an export sales alliance last July.
"It was to show that we were serious," an executive said on Friday.

Swedish holding company Proventus on Friday said that it now held 21.1 percent of the glassmaker with an option on another 9.1 percent and was bidding for a further 20 percent in order to take control and block any further Royal Copenhagen plans.

"The logic behind the (Royal Copenhagen) acquisition does not exclude the possibility that Royal Copenhagen has the ambition to increase its holding to create a Danish-controlled group," it said. --Eva Elgaard Pedersen, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33 969650
